about: Prototype quality standards checklist adapted for Localizer review from CHW AIM. This is program-quality scaffolding, not clinical guidance.
reviewStatus: CODEX Decision - program-quality scaffolding adapted from CHW AIM for Localizer review; not clinical guidance; pending owner review

source.title: CHW AIM: Updated Program Functionality Matrix for Optimizing Community Health Programs
source.publisher: UNICEF / USAID / Community Health Impact Coalition / Initiatives Inc.

components.label: Role and recruitment
components.prototypeCheck: Each module names the intended caregiver/CHW role and avoids implying professional scope beyond referral, reminder, coaching, or checklist support.

components.label: Training
components.prototypeCheck: Every new workflow needs a short CHW training note, plain-language script, or demo path before field use.

components.label: Accreditation
components.prototypeCheck: The prototype must not claim certification, credentialing, or formal competency validation.

components.label: Equipment and supplies
components.prototypeCheck: Modules that depend on product packages, ORS/zinc, chlorine, phones, timers, or referral cards must show asset and supply provenance.

components.label: Supervision
components.prototypeCheck: High-risk content must remain in the approval queue until a supervising clinical/local reviewer signs it off.

components.label: Incentives
components.prototypeCheck: Do not create performance incentives from prototype learning signals; keep dashboards synthetic until governance exists.

components.label: Community involvement
components.prototypeCheck: Story, image, and localization choices require local review for respect, dignity, and cultural fit.

components.label: Opportunity for advancement
components.prototypeCheck: Training/readiness outputs are placeholders and must not be represented as career advancement or formal assessment.

components.label: Data
components.prototypeCheck: Real data is blocked in this PWA; only synthetic family records, synthetic signals, and export demos are allowed.

components.label: Linkages to the health system
components.prototypeCheck: Referral and reminder modules must preserve local clinic/CHW linkage placeholders and avoid pretending alerts are reliable when the phone sleeps.
